label: NON-CAUSAL / MODEL-CONSISTENT

plain_english.disclaimer: NON-CAUSAL / MODEL-CONSISTENT: these figures compare recommendation policies under Play It Out's hiring funnel numeric model and deadline-event Monte Carlo with explicit parameter overrides. They are not randomized controlled trial average treatment effects and must not be reported as real-world causal action impact.
plain_english.causal_panel_status: No public RCT / credible quasi-experimental personal-action panel with treatment variation loaded in this worktree. Full OULAD studentVle.csv is not present under data/, so no observational study-intensity associative proxy was computed.
plain_english.top1: Across 36 simulator ranking cases, a greedy uplift/hour policy picked the best single action 8% of the time; equal-proxy 36%; random 19%; oracle 100%.
plain_english.policy_value: Mean model-consistent policy uplift under the hours budget: greedy 0.2648, equal-proxy 0.1323, random 0.2327, oracle 0.2739.
plain_english.regret: Mean regret vs oracle (probability points left on the table): greedy 0.0091, equal-proxy 0.1416, random 0.0413.
plain_english.upside_captured: Mean fraction of oracle upside captured: greedy 95%, equal-proxy 55%, random 73%.
plain_english.best_action_mix: Oracle best-action frequencies across the case grid: applications=23, response_rate=13.
plain_english.reuse_note: Extends hackathon_proof_v1 policy_regret_model_consistent with a multi-case ranking grid (baseline application rate × stage-prior scale × budget) and greedy/equal/random/oracle comparisons on model-priced hiring levers (weekly applications + stage conversion priors).

limitations: Additive bundle value approximation (no joint multi-override MC interaction)
Hours costs are fixed product estimates, not measured opportunity costs
Stage-rate actions are exploration priors in the hiring reference model, not RCT effects
No RCT ATE panel loaded; no OULAD associative proxy computed (data absent)
